stage: numerical rules fixed after structural selection, before numerical code or reference navigation parsing
reference_navigation: BRDM00DLR_S_20262490000_01D_MN.rnx.gz from BKG; retain only G records other than G08 before numerical parsing; no target bias or clock product
clock_field: Ignore optional receiver-generated epoch clock fields; re-estimate effective clock using non-target codes. Require absent/zero RCV CLOCK OFFS APPL, GPS time, no code scale or applied DCB/PCV corrections.
reference_model: Legacy GPS broadcast position and polynomial plus eccentricity clock correction at iterated transmit time. IF C1C/C2W, no TGD correction to IF; unresolved C1C-vs-P1 bias included in error budget. Earth rotation at light time included. Nominal troposphere (2.3 exp(-0.000116 h)+0.1)*1.001/sqrt(0.002001+sin(e)^2), using height from WGS84 coordinates. Include antenna H/E/N offset.
reference_selection: Healthy non-target GPS, nearest toc within 7200 s; elevation at least 10 deg. At least four at every station/epoch. Fixed equal weights, scalar clock mean, no residual clipping. Sorted PRNs split alternating indices for subset controls.
calibration_admission: Every epoch: absolute reference residual <=50 m, RMS <=20 m, split-subset clock difference <=30 m. Full-window independent non-target station-position-plus-clock fit: 3D offset from header antenna coordinate <=30 m; position Jacobian full rank. No correction of target using fitted station-coordinate offsets.
target_transform: Work in seconds relative to central 150 s GPST. u_j=t_j-P_IF_j/c. u0=median of five fit central tags. Interpolate z_j=P_IF_j-a_j at u0 using four closest emission tags, require bracketing. Receiver coordinates rotated to fixed ECEF axes at u0 using T_i=u0+z_i/c. No extrapolation. Compare degree-3 to degree-5 interpolation, require difference <=2 m.
target_solver: Scaled five-root squared-range linear initialization, followed by original unsquared nonlinear least squares including nominal troposphere computed from unknown x. No target orbit/radius/clock seed. Additional initializers are all four-root algebraic branches, no catalogue. Domain requires all fit roots see elevation >=5 deg, positive geometric light times, and finite solution. Multiple acceptable branches reject uniqueness.
fit_admission: Full-rank Jacobian, each absolute residual <=100 m. Multiple physical solutions with cost within 7.815 of best whitened cost reject uniqueness. Profile best and worst covariance axes and evaluate nonlinearity before oracle.
uncertainty: Gaussian per-root observation floor sigma=20 m; increase to maximum of this floor and worst reference RMS or split-subset difference. Propagate code into BOTH emission tag and interpolated z including median u0. Non-target satellite common equivalent range error sigma=5 m, correlated across every station sharing that reference. Ground coordinate sigma=5 m per Cartesian component, correlated over time within a station. For residual direction-dependent code/hardware/atmosphere/interpolation, add a bounded per-root bias ±20 m; this is an explicit conditional design envelope, not a universal measured hardware bound. Full nonlinear fits of all 32 bias-box corners; outer 95% radius = worst bias displacement plus maximum 95% statistical semiaxis including nonlinear axis probes. A priori primary limit stays 10000 m even if failed.
holdout_prediction: Given frozen xyz and B, solve reception at GOLD and predict corrected pseudorange z=rho+B+troposphere in the same event frame; freeze predictive sigma plus systematic envelope without seeing GOLD target. GOLD non-target clock calibration is allowed before freeze. Absolute residual limit 100 m and <=3sigma plus systematic envelope.
oracle: After frozen solution even if declared uncertainty too large, optional diagnostic comparison remains labelled failed primary. Nine nearest SP3 position nodes, degree-8 Lagrange interpolation at solved emission time, with 10 m oracle/reference-point allowance. Fixed ECEF-u0 to ECEF-emission rotation. No fitted time shift/rotation/translation. Difference to eight-node interpolation reported as oracle interpolation control; >10 m rejects oracle accuracy qualification.
after_reveal: No tuning, re-fitting, threshold changes, target changes, or window changes using holdout/oracle results. Implementation defects, if found, explicitly invalidate the attempted proof rather than create an unreported retry.
interpretation: All error coverage is conditional on the declared statistical and systematic model; one-event agreement is not a calibration of population coverage. A G08-labelled position does not establish satellite identity autonomously.
